_help: Everything the bot says comes from this file. Edit the lists, keep the JSON valid, restart the bot.
Placeholders: {name} the station we answer, {me} our node name, {location} one of the 'locations' from config.json
picked at random, {hops} 'direct, no repeater' / '3 hops', {snr} and {rssi} of the message we heard,
{greeting} hello/hi/hey/howdy. Lines with {snr} are skipped when the SNR is unknown.
Every line then goes through the human pass from config.json (short words, the odd typo).
quick: ready-made lines in the send window (Enter key). emoticons: the buttons in the send window.

operator_replies: what /reply (key a) puts in the input line for you to send by hand: {name} {hops} {via} (via Repeater>Repeater, or direct) {snr} {location} (operator_location in config.json, else the first of locations). No human pass.
snippets: your saved lines. {{key}} in a message, or the window that opens when you type {{ (add, edit and delete them there). Fields like {hops} are allowed inside.
replies: @[{name}] hearing you ok, {hops}. how about you?
@[{name}] hi from {location}, what radio you got?
@[{name}] first time hearing you, where are you?
beacons: hi all, {me} in {location}, who hears me?
{location} here, how is the mesh your side?
quick: good copy here, how do you hear me?
where are you? im in Springfield

snippets.hop: {hops} {via} from {location}, hope the nodes are holding up
